craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of joined debate — Sāṅkhya fairly stated then page-turned. Again-and-again joy-proving; nothing-hard close. Rejected: (a) single again → killed: repetition is ease. Read aloud: THROUGH-that … NO-change WOULD-be-HARD at-ALL.

lines: Through that, proving spirit's joy again and again —
no change would be hard at all.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tenāsya bhogasaṃsiddhiḥ puruṣasya yathā yathā tathā tathā pariṇatiḥ syānna kiṃcana durghaṭam

reads_against.argmap: How easy is change? → Change comes easy, again and again, for spirit's enjoyment.
c1_essence: Sāṅkhya stated at full strength: pradhāna proved by presence, purposed by denying self-aims; change easy; only striving moves; nature faces down (vv19-22).
The page turns on admitted karma: where is His business? Let His triggering be conceived; seed imaged; Sāṅkhya godless; conditional close (vv23-27).
